_note: A REAL host, not a fixture. OCTO-W01 is the estate workstation; the two accelerator seats, their VRAM, PCI coordinates and GPU UUIDs are as recorded in the estate base seal 100.110.OCTO_W01_BASE_SEAL.md, where that machine metadata is intentionally public. The three weight quantities are the estate's own measurement of Kimi-K3 and they close exactly: tensor payload 1560860324864 B plus safetensors container headers 75766584 B is the complete 96-shard checkpoint set 1560936091448 B. What this manifest deliberately does NOT carry is the object digest. An accepted Rung 1A identity for this weight set exists, under scheme estate/object-residence@1, in a PRIVATE evidence repository; identity_source below names exactly where. Copying that digest into a public repository would export custody evidence from a private packet, so model.identity declares identity_state UNVERIFIED_HERE and the planner refuses with UNVERIFIED_MODEL_IDENTITY. That refusal is the honest artifact. A syntactically valid invented digest would be worse than no digest at all, because a downstream reader could not tell it from real custody.
